$schema_note: Copy this file to your project as .preflight/config.json and edit for your project.
_comment_rubric: Path (string) or paths (array) to review rubrics. Array form enables multi-rubric modes: ["rubric-api-design.md", "rubric-generic.md"]. If omitted, plugin defaults are used based on mode.
_comment_capture: Paths for the self-improvement capture files. Created on first use.
_comment_branch: base = the protected target branch; remote = the intended push target. forbiddenRemotes/forbiddenRepos are an EXPLICIT denylist the pre-push guard checks the RESOLVED target against, REGARDLESS of 'remote' — set these on a clone whose 'origin' (or any remote) points at a legacy/production repo that must never be pushed to. forbiddenRemotes = remote NAMES; forbiddenRepos = owner/repo slugs or full URLs. Guard is agent-Bash-tool-only and fail-open (empty lists = inert) — not server-side protection. PER-CLONE OVERRIDE: if THIS clone's topology differs from the committed values (e.g. an inverted clone where the real push target is a different remote), do NOT edit this committed file — create a gitignored .preflight/config.local.json with only the topology keys to override (branch.remote/base/migrationPrefix, migration.*). Gate thresholds, loop/review policy, rubric, and the forbidden lists are NOT overridable locally (see lib/config-overlay.sh).

test._comment: Command to run tests. Auto-detected if null (dotnet test for .NET, npm test for Node).
test._comment_coverageBaseline: null = no hard numeric gate pinned in config; during migration runs the migrate skill applies its documented 85% fallback floor (Check 5). Set an explicit number (e.g. 96.0) to pin the gate for your team. Lowering a configured baseline is a reviewed change — and NOT overridable via config.local.json (the overlay allowlist in lib/config-overlay.sh excludes test.*).
